meta.title: Order Activity records a vendor submitting a bid
gaps: Exact vendor name recorded for the submission
Exact date and time of the activity entry
Complete chronological ordering and confirmation that no earlier entries are missing
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Exact vendor name recorded for the submission; Exact date and time of the activity entry; Complete chronological ordering and confirmation that no earlier entries are missing

steps.note: Start a buyer-side event so the subsequent vendor bid and activity entry belong to this plan's event.
Give the event the required title before publishing.
Apply the first available pricing template.
Add one line item for the vendor to quote.
Complete the pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Invite one QA vendor who can submit the bid.
Publish the event before attempting vendor bidding.
Verify the event reached a real published project page.
Have the invited QA vendor submit a bid through the vendor portal.
Confirm the vendor submission was accepted.
Open the stage Order Activity drawer where the submission history is shown.
Verify the Order Activity drawer is open.
Verify the activity view contains bid-related content for the vendor submission.
